subject: [PATCH 8/8] selftests/mm: check that unauthorized MADV_PAGEOUT skips large file folios

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Addressed a concern about verifying that the underlying folio was not split by the partial-range madvise. The patch author believes this is a false-positive and splitting a file folio would unmap it entirely.

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch series adds selftests to verify that MADV_PAGEOUT behaves correctly when a caller attempts to page out large file folios without permission. The tests check that the operation leaves every page of a PMD-sized shmem folio resident, both when mapped with PMDs and PTEs.
